task: Review this export completion notification for accuracy. The notification claims the file was uploaded to a cloud library; the supplied facts show it was saved locally. Identify the incorrect destination and the missing local path information.
input: Export complete. Your PDF has been uploaded to your cloud library.

facts.text: The PDF was saved to the local Downloads folder, not to any cloud service.
No cloud upload occurred during or after the export.
The application does not have a cloud library feature.
The export success notification should inform the user where the file was saved.

forbidden_additions: Acceptance of the cloud upload claim when the file was saved locally.
Acceptance of the cloud library reference when no such feature exists.
preserve: File location belongs in the notification per the supplied facts.
